title: Nightshift shift defaults
description: Remembered convenience choices in .nightshift/shift-defaults.json. They prefill the one question a composition step asks and nothing else: the resolver never reports them as the source of an effective value, and they never carry elevation. A missing or malformed file means the built-in defaults (fast, no hours, existing-tools, review-first).

schemaVersion.description: Defaults schema version. Only 1 is supported.

verificationProfile.description: Last verification profile. The resolver maps it to a level only when a composition step or Start copies it into the shift policy: fast to none, balanced to final, strict to per-item, custom to custom.

hours.description: Typical shift length in whole hours, or null for a finite shift with no clock.

toolingPolicy.description: Last tooling policy. Artifact mode still refuses the repository-tool policies.

execution.description: Whether the last composition reviewed the plan before arming or armed straight away.

updatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the last write, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).
